svg.title: How Paracortex works
svg.desc: Two rows. When you index: your Markdown notes are scanned (exclusions, no symlinks, UTF-8 only) into a local index with a full-text table, a link graph and the SHA-256 of every note. When you ask: the question is searched with BM25 full-text search and optionally expanded along explicit links; every source is re-hashed and compared with the index, changed notes are withheld; the evidence packet goes to the agent through the CLI, the MCP server or the prompt hook.
